title: Hochschild-Cohomology Lie Structure of a Stratified Algebra
statement: Let $K$ have characteristic $2$, let $B=\begin{pmatrix}K(\mathbb Z_2\times\mathbb Z_2)&K\mathbb Z_2\\0&K\end{pmatrix}$ with stratifying idempotent $e=\begin{pmatrix}0&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$. Determine the precise Lie algebra structure of $\operatorname{HH}^*(B)$, and decide whether the long exact sequence from $0\to BeB\to B\to B/BeB\to0$ determines it.
